Class PersistencyManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am43.controller.PersistencyManager
public class PersistencyManager extends Object
Manages disk serialization and recovery routines for server resilience. Implements crash-safe atomic disk writing routines and handles initial snapshot recovery.

  • Method Details

    • saveRecovery

      public static void saveRecovery(GameRecovery game, String id)
      Serializes a model snapshot state to disk using an atomic file write procedure. Writes to a temporary .tmp file first before atomically replacing the final destination file, ensuring existing records remain safe from intermediate corruption.
      Parameters:
      game - the GameRecovery snapshot containing model state data structures
      id - the lobby identifier used as the unique filename prefix

    • loadSavedStatus

      public static void loadSavedStatus(ServerController serverController)
      Scans the default recovery directory for lingering recovery files and instructs the server controller to recreate previously active lobbies.
      Parameters:
      serverController - the server orchestrator handling recovered lobbies

    • deleteRecovery

      public static void deleteRecovery(int id)
      Permanently deletes a specific lobby snapshot from the disk memory. Executed when a match reaches conclusion.
      Parameters:
      id - the lobby identifier whose backup data is to be removed
